event_graph_dsl:
(event EventBeginPlay
  (Collision|SetCollisionResponseToChannel (Variables|Character|GetCapsuleComponent) "ECC_Visibility" "ECR_Block")
  (CallFunction|SpawnSearchers)
  (CallFunction|RefreshObjective))

(event Collision|EventActorBeginOverlap (OtherActor))

(event EventTick (DeltaSeconds)
  (bind _returnvalue (Game|GetPlayerController 0))
  (bind _deltax (Game|Player|GetInputMouseDelta _returnvalue))
  (Variables|Default|SetDebugMoveTime (- (Variables|Default|GetDebugMoveTime) DeltaSeconds))
  (if (<= (Variables|Default|GetDebugMoveTime) 0.0)
    (Variables|Default|SetDebugForward 0.0)
    (Variables|Default|SetDebugRight 0.0)
    (Variables|Default|SetDebugLook 0.0))
  (if (or (Game|Player|WasInputKeyJustPressed _returnvalue "R") (Variables|Default|GetRequestRestart))
    (Variables|Default|SetRequestRestart false)
    (CallFunction|Restart))
  (if (not (Variables|Default|GetDead))
    (Pawn|Input|AddControllerYawInput (+ (* _deltax 0.6) (* (Variables|Default|GetDebugLook) DeltaSeconds)))
    (Pawn|Input|AddControllerPitchInput (* (Game|Player|GetInputMouseDelta _returnvalue) -0.6))
    (Variables|Default|SetLookTotal (+ (Variables|Default|GetLookTotal) (+ (* _deltax _deltax) (* (Variables|Default|GetDebugLook) DeltaSeconds))))
    (Pawn|Input|AddMovementInput (Transformation|GetActorForwardVector) (+ (Variables|Default|GetDebugForward) (- (select (Game|Player|IsInputKeyDown _returnvalue "W") 1.0 0.0) (select (Game|Player|IsInputKeyDown _returnvalue "S") 1.0 0.0))))
    (Pawn|Input|AddMovementInput (Transformation|GetActorRightVector) (+ (Variables|Default|GetDebugRight) (- (select (Game|Player|IsInputKeyDown _returnvalue "D") 1.0 0.0) (select (Game|Player|IsInputKeyDown _returnvalue "A") 1.0 0.0))))
    (if (or (Game|Player|IsInputKeyDown _returnvalue "C") (Variables|Default|GetDebugCrouch))
      (Character|Crouch)
      (else
        (Character|UnCrouch)))
    (if (or (Game|Player|WasInputKeyJustPressed _returnvalue "SpaceBar") (Variables|Default|GetRequestJump))
      (Variables|Default|SetRequestJump false)
      (Character|Jump))
    (if (or (Game|Player|WasInputKeyJustPressed _returnvalue "E") (Variables|Default|GetRequestInteract))
      (Variables|Default|SetRequestInteract false)
      (CallFunction|Interact))
    (Variables|Default|SetShotCooldown (- (Variables|Default|GetShotCooldown) DeltaSeconds))
    (if (or (Game|Player|IsInputKeyDown _returnvalue "LeftMouseButton") (Variables|Default|GetRequestFire))
      (CallFunction|Fire)
      (Variables|Default|SetRequestFire false))
    (CallFunction|RecoveryChecks))
  (Variables|Default|SetSubtitleTime (- (Variables|Default|GetSubtitleTime) DeltaSeconds))
  (if (<= (Variables|Default|GetSubtitleTime) 0.0)
    (Variables|Default|SetSubtitle "")
    (if (> (Utilities|Array|Length (Variables|Default|GetSubtitleQueue)) 0)
      (Variables|Default|SetSubtitle (Utilities|Array|Get(acopy) (Variables|Default|GetSubtitleQueue)))
      (Utilities|Array|RemoveIndex (Variables|Default|GetSubtitleQueue))
      (Variables|Default|SetSubtitleTime 6.0))))

(event Game|Damage|EventAnyDamage (Damage DamageType InstigatedBy DamageCauser)
  (if (not (Variables|Default|GetDead))
    (Variables|Default|SetHealth (- (Variables|Default|GetHealth) Damage))
    (if (<= (Variables|Default|GetHealth) 0.0)
      (Variables|Default|SetDead true)
      (Variables|Default|SetObjective "You died. Press R to restart at the checkpoint."))))
